examples.title: Example 1: Using the Default Refreshing Style
examples.description: This example implements a Refresh component with its refreshing area in the default style.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Text Displayed in the Refreshing Area
examples.description: This example shows how to set the text displayed in the refreshing area using the promptText parameter.

examples.title: Example 3: Customizing the Refreshing Area Content with builder
examples.description: This example shows how to customize the content displayed in the refreshing area using the builder parameter.

examples.title: Example 4: Customizing the Refreshing Area Content with refreshingContent
examples.description: This example shows how to customize the content displayed in the refreshing area using the refreshingContent parameter.

examples.title: Example 5: Implementing the Maximum Pull-down Distance
examples.description: This example shows how to use the pullDownRatio attribute and the onOffsetChange event to implement the maximum pull-down distance.

examples.title: Example 6: Implementing Pull-Down-to-Refresh and Pull-Up-to-Load-More
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to combine the Refresh component with the List component to implement pull-down-to-refresh and pull-up-to-load-more features.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting the Maximum Pull-Down Distance
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the maximum pull-down distance using the maxPullDownDistance attribute, supported since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 8: Disabling Pull-to-Refresh
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to disable pull-to-refresh using the pullDownRatio attribute.

examples.title: Example 9: Implementing Pull-to-Refresh in the Non-Full-Screen Scenario
examples.description: When calling edgeEffect, set alwaysEnabled of the options parameter to true to implement the pull-to-refresh effect of the Refresh component in the non-full-screen scenario.

examples.title: Example 10: Disabling Pull-Up-to-Cancel
examples.description:
This example shows how to disable the pull-up-to-cancel gesture for refreshing operations using the pullUpToCancelRefresh API.
The pullUpToCancelRefresh API is supported since API version 23.
